description: This file contains Makefile snippets for building root filesystem images, including conditional definitions for mklibs, opkg package management, and root filesystem preparation scripts.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Defines a script to find and process executable and shared object files, then create stripped libraries using mklibs.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines the command for package management operations with specific options.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes unnecessary files and cleans up opkg status information.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem by copying files, enabling/disabling init scripts, and cleaning up temporary files.
